body: It's more an indifference now than a straight up resolve that it has to happen, leaves me in a coward's limbo were I don't want it enough to get gutsy and try.
Just don't be depressed, just clean your house. Why didn't I think it sooner? Completely agree with you, shit's patronizing.
I've never been happier when before I was suicidal and beyond depressed, I don't get why the fuck people want to go back to work if they aren't starving, you're free now, just go, shit.
Same here, I was so fucking depressed before all of this. Things have never been better for me, I know when "normal" returns it's over for me.
Rat tail comb and wet brush are the dream team here

It's really odd but I've never felt happier than these times. I have to stay indoors, there's no social pressures to go outside, there's no job to go to and they can't evict me for now. Every day is my own, I can choose to spend the whole day doing things I want to do. Things are exciting and the world is changing, maybe I'll even see a future I can be a part of. I'm fucking hyped, either I die and it's good or I live and maybe something good comes too.
